items.title: Earl Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 7, 2002
items.q: So I said, “Well I’ll go with you. I’ll send my drums ahead and I’ll go with you.” So anyhow we drove.

ctx.x: Terry Gibbs, yeah. They did a duo at the Black Hawk. Anyhow that was the second week. But the first week okay, and then at the end of our second week there why George Duvivier, because Mulligan did the whole two weeks so George said, “Well I’m heading for the coast,” he said, “I’m driving.” He said, “Yeah,” he says he had a ’50 Cadillac with a ’54 engine in it and he loved to drive. So I said, “Well I’ll go with you. I’ll send my drums ahead and I’ll go with you.” So anyhow we drove. That was 1955. So we drove…

what happened, the powers that be down there, the other casinos, the crowds would leave. So there was no action, you know, the slot machines and the gambling, it cut in on their action, so as a result I guess they somehow forced the closure.
